selection_rule: Select and adapt only the smallest applicable set. Every workflow node must bind a resource listed here; no node should invent an unpinned capability or reference an absent artifact. Prefer prompt+agent+verification for simple projects; add research, skills, and policy resources only when the spec or DAG demands them.

artifacts.purpose: Intent-preserving responder for repair/integration with bounded authority.
artifacts.use_when: A Codex node repairs, integrates, or adapts existing behavior.
artifacts.avoid_when: Greenfield build with no existing behavior to preserve.

artifacts.purpose: Greenfield/feature builder that implements the smallest satisfying change.
artifacts.use_when: A node creates new capability from a spec.
artifacts.avoid_when: The node is verification, research, or review only.

artifacts.purpose: Evidence-driven verifier that never redefines completion.
artifacts.use_when: A test, review, or gate node must produce pass/fail evidence.
artifacts.avoid_when: The node must write implementation files.

artifacts.purpose: Bounded synthesizer that produces a knowledge artifact, not code.
artifacts.use_when: A research operation must resolve load-bearing unknowns before implementation.
artifacts.avoid_when: The spec has no unknowns that change implementation.

artifacts.purpose: Start bounded implementation from approved intent and repo evidence.
artifacts.use_when: A node changes project implementation.
artifacts.avoid_when: The node is read-only research, review, or reporting.

artifacts.purpose: Verify observable acceptance criteria with command evidence.
artifacts.use_when: The workflow makes testable claims.
artifacts.avoid_when: No executable or inspectable result exists.

artifacts.purpose: Adversarial review of an immutable checkpoint.
artifacts.use_when: Independent review is required by spec or risk.
artifacts.avoid_when: The reviewer cannot be independent from the work.

artifacts.purpose: Return verified deliverables without importing deliberation.
artifacts.use_when: The workflow produces a durable result.
artifacts.avoid_when: No separate handoff is needed.

artifacts.purpose: Bounded synthesis into a knowledge artifact.
artifacts.use_when: An unknown blocks correct implementation.
artifacts.avoid_when: Implementation can proceed without prior synthesis.

artifacts.purpose: Evidence-backed report from inspected state.
artifacts.use_when: A report or handoff manifest must be produced.
artifacts.avoid_when: The node only verifies without reporting.

artifacts.purpose: Translate one capability into interfaces, data shapes, and test cases.
artifacts.use_when: A feature needs design before sequencing work.
artifacts.avoid_when: The feature is a small scoped change with obvious interfaces.

artifacts.purpose: Typed, versioned interface between subsystems.
artifacts.use_when: Two subsystems exchange typed data.
artifacts.avoid_when: No cross-component contract is required.

artifacts.purpose: Decompose objective into sequenced phases, scopes, and evidence.
artifacts.use_when: A workflow must be sequenced before detailed composition.
artifacts.avoid_when: The composition is a known minimal pattern.

artifacts.purpose: Drive implementation through failing-then-passing tests.
artifacts.use_when: An agent node lists testable acceptance criteria.
artifacts.avoid_when: The node is research or reporting only.

artifacts.purpose: Produce a strict schema with valid/invalid examples.
artifacts.use_when: A boundary needs a machine-checkable contract.
artifacts.avoid_when: No typed exchange crosses a boundary.

artifacts.purpose: Docs generated from observable code, not spec copy.
artifacts.use_when: Delivery requires README or run docs.
artifacts.avoid_when: No user-facing doc is deliverable.

artifacts.purpose: Semantic, CSP-compliant canvas rendering without code injection.
artifacts.use_when: A node must present a planner/configurator/reviewer UI.
artifacts.avoid_when: The project has no browser canvas.

artifacts.purpose: Keep runtime intervention capture sparse and bounded.
artifacts.use_when: The workflow permits adaptive local repair.
artifacts.avoid_when: Execution is read-only or adaptation forbidden.

artifacts.purpose: Disjoint scopes or ordered writers; grammar and concurrency analysis.
artifacts.use_when: Parallel writers exist or scope overlap is possible.
artifacts.avoid_when: The graph is strictly linear.

artifacts.purpose: Independent review must precede approval; bounded remediation.
artifacts.use_when: User approval requires an independent pass.
artifacts.avoid_when: No independent review is required.

artifacts.purpose: Narrow intent-preserving deviation ladder.
artifacts.use_when: Physical reality may invalidate a detail of the plan.
artifacts.avoid_when: Strict literalism is required and any deviation is a failure.

artifacts.purpose: Bounded, finding-specific repair without cycles.
artifacts.use_when: A review node permits repair attempts.
artifacts.avoid_when: The policy requires immediate user decision on failure.

artifacts.purpose: Linear input→implement→test→gate→handoff.
artifacts.use_when: Single feature, no parallel work, no research.
artifacts.avoid_when: Parallel branches or research needed.

artifacts.purpose: Parallel agents with disjoint scopes joined by all.
artifacts.use_when: Two or more independent subsystems.
artifacts.avoid_when: Writes would overlap without ordering.

artifacts.purpose: Research produces knowledge artifact consumed by implementation.
artifacts.use_when: Load-bearing unknown precedes code.
artifacts.avoid_when: Implementation can proceed without synthesis.

artifacts.purpose: Full research→implement→verify→review→report→checkpoint→handoff.
artifacts.use_when: An evidence-backed handoff must survive independent review.
artifacts.avoid_when: Review or checkpoint not required.

artifacts.purpose: Decision table for choosing DAG shape and join strategy.
artifacts.use_when: Selecting between minimal/parallel/research/full templates.
artifacts.avoid_when: The spec maps trivially to one template.

artifacts.purpose: Repository layout, tooling, branch, and scope conventions.
artifacts.use_when: Implementation nodes benefit from knowing actual layout up front.
artifacts.avoid_when: The workflow is repo-agnostic.

artifacts.purpose: One-page product purpose, non-goals, constraints, criteria, glossary.
artifacts.use_when: Scoped agents need concise approved intent.
artifacts.avoid_when: No separate product context is needed.

artifacts.purpose: Per-criterion pass/fail/unverifiable with evidence.
artifacts.use_when: A verification or test node must produce a report.
artifacts.avoid_when: Evidence is fully captured in test output alone.

artifacts.purpose: Verified deliverables, evidence pointers, checkpoint, manifest, unresolved decisions.
artifacts.use_when: The handoff node returns to the primary context.
artifacts.avoid_when: No primary-context handoff is needed.

artifacts.purpose: Field type, validation, and provenance patterns for good specification forms.
artifacts.use_when: A clarification canvas must add new blocker fields.
artifacts.avoid_when: The spec is already ready and no new fields are needed.

artifacts.purpose: Template for repository AGENTS.md steering that scoped agents consume.
artifacts.use_when: The workflow needs durable per-project agent instructions.
artifacts.avoid_when: The project has no persisted AGENTS.md.
